run_f_gold: run f_gold to count factorial numbers within a given low and high range
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets to verify factorial range counting correctness
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a more efficient algorithm for counting factorial numbers in a range
review_f_gold: review f_gold logic that iteratively computes factorials and counts those within the specified range
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which counts how many factorial numbers fall between a low and high bound
